# Quizzman Fabric
> Modular Framework + Runtime for composable Quizzman web apps (tokens, UI, header, chat embed).
> Formerly QMF (Quizzman Modular Framework). Package scope `@qmf/*` and CDN path `/qmf/` are unchanged.
> Use this file to discover public documentation for AI agents and crawlers.

## Product
- Name: Quizzman Fabric (Modular Framework + Runtime)
- Short / code: QMF (legacy acronym — still used in `@qmf/*`, `/qmf/`, `QMF` global)
- CDN home: https://ui.quizzman.com/
- Docs shell: https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/docs.html
- npm packages: `@qmf/core`, `@qmf/tokens`, `@qmf/ui`, `@qmf/header`, `@qmf/chat-embed`
- Marketing: https://quizzman.com/

## Related Quizzman products (AI discovery)
- Slide Studio (Markdown slides): https://app.quizzman.com/slide-studio/llms.txt
- Slide Studio about: https://app.quizzman.com/slide-studio/about
- App platform: https://app.quizzman.com/

## Quick start (CDN)
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/v3/tokens.css">
<script src="https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/v3/qmf.iife.js"></script>
<script>
  QMF.init({ appId: 'my-app', debug: true }).then(() => console.log('QMF Ready'));
</script>
```

Stable CDN entries also include:
- https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/v3/qmf.min.js
- https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/dist/qmf.min.js
- https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/assets/

## What QMF is for
- Shared design tokens and UI primitives across Quizzman products
- Dynamic header / settings island
- Chat embed and modular frontend services
- Consistent theming for Lab, Wiki, App, Dict, and other subdomains

## Related Lab tools that load QMF
- Lab: https://lab.quizzman.com/llms.txt
- Lab about I-Ching: https://lab.quizzman.com/tool/about-iching
- Lab about Calendar: https://lab.quizzman.com/tool/about-calendar

## Crawl policy
- Allow indexing and AI grounding of `/qmf/docs/*.md`, `docs.html`, `llms.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, and public `v3/` / `dist/` entry assets.
- Deny internal/source trees: `kernel/`, `services/`, `plugins/`, `scripts/`, `node_modules/`, `_src/`, `*.internal.md`.
- Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes
- robots.txt: https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/robots.txt
- sitemap: https://ui.quizzman.com/qmf/sitemap.xml
